sourcePolicy.method: Convert the already manually researched NIRF batch-007 candidates now supported by the typed reviewer pipeline; additionally inspect official MNNIT annual-report and IIM Calcutta admissions materials directly. No bulk crawl or access-control bypass.
sourcePolicy.factualUse: Store concise factual values with exact official publisher, URL, academic/reporting year and evidence locator only. NIRF facts were manually researched in batch 007; MNNIT/IIMC facts were directly opened and inspected during batch 019.
sourcePolicy.reuseConditions: No bulk reproduction or source document storage. NIRF and MNNIT PDF terms do not establish blanket bulk reuse permission; factual values remain internal STAGED claims with citation, and public display still requires human verification of source, identity, freshness and intended-use terms. IIMC page does not establish bulk automated collection/republication permission; only short factual summaries and direct source link are retained. Do not infer permission for automated harvesting.
